notes: The spec path PATCH /workspaces/{wId}/policies/{policyId}/requests/{requestId} does not exist on live Clockify. GET returns 'No static resource' confirming Spring-MVC routing miss. The corresponding time-off-prefixed path GET /workspaces/{wId}/time-off/policies/{policyId}/requests/{requestId} returns HTTP 405 'Request method GET is not supported', confirming that path IS registered server-side and PATCH would be the live method. The spec entry uses the non-prefixed 'policies' path which is absent; the live path family is under '/time-off/policies/'. Our raw_allowlist_gen.go includes BOTH the non-prefixed (74-75) and time-off-prefixed (143,147) variants.
